scripts.dev:shell:clean: pnpm run clean:src-js && pnpm run dev:shell
scripts.prepare:workspace-surfaces: corepack pnpm --filter @nimiplatform/sdk build && corepack pnpm --filter @nimiplatform/kit build
scripts.check:cargo: pnpm run prepare:desktop-release && pnpm run check:desktop-release-sync && cargo check --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.check:cargo:clippy: pnpm run prepare:desktop-release && pnpm run check:desktop-release-sync && pnpm run check:cargo:clippy:prepared
scripts.check:cargo:test: pnpm run prepare:desktop-release && pnpm run check:desktop-release-sync && pnpm run check:cargo:test:prepared
scripts.check:cargo:quality: pnpm run prepare:desktop-release && pnpm run check:desktop-release-sync && pnpm run check:cargo:clippy:prepared && pnpm run check:cargo:test:prepared
scripts.check:cargo:runtime-bridge: pnpm run prepare:desktop-release && pnpm run check:desktop-release-sync && cargo test --locked runtime_bridge --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:electron: pnpm run prepare:workspace-surfaces && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && node scripts/bundle-electron-main.mjs && node scripts/bundle-electron-preload.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run check:version-sync && pnpm run check:cargo
scripts.test:quality: pnpm run i18n:check && pnpm run i18n:audit && pnpm run check:e2e-parity
scripts.test:unit:prepared: pnpm run test:unit:i18n && pnpm run test:unit:rest
scripts.test:e2e:electron: corepack pnpm run build:renderer && corepack pnpm run build:electron && node --test test/electron-acceptance.mjs
scripts.test:macos:electron:negative-acceptance: pnpm run build:renderer && pnpm run build:electron && node scripts/run-macos-negative-electron-acceptance.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:electron:live-runtime: corepack pnpm run build:renderer && corepack pnpm run build:electron && node scripts/run-electron-live-runtime-acceptance.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:electron:supervised-desktop-ope: corepack pnpm run build:renderer && corepack pnpm run build:electron && node test/electron-supervised-desktop-open-live.mjs
